boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named UCR places for studying, making, recreation, campus programs, and time outdoors.

cards.title: Tomás Rivera Library
cards.subtitle: Library study spaces
cards.notes: Choose an open table for solo work, or reserve a group room with classmates using your UCR NetID before meeting.
cards.short_summary: A library building with open, quiet, and reservable study options.
cards.evidence_claim: UCR Libraries lists open study areas and reservable group study rooms in Rivera Library; its second floor is a designated quiet floor.
cards.access_notes: Group rooms are available to UCR students, staff, and faculty and require a UCR NetID reservation.

cards.title: Orbach Science Library
cards.subtitle: Science library study space
cards.notes: Use the open seating or book a group room; check the library’s current hours before planning a longer work session.
cards.short_summary: A campus library with study carrels, group rooms, and an atrium.
cards.evidence_claim: UCR reports that Orbach has an atrium, large windows, study carrel desks, and group study rooms reservable online.
cards.source_title: Orbach Library fully reopens to campus | Inside UCR
cards.access_notes: The library’s full building reopened to campus in March 2026; room reservations are handled online.

cards.title: Creat’R Lab
cards.subtitle: Orbach Library, Room 140
cards.notes: Bring a project idea and use the makerspace’s listed tools for 3D printing, sewing or Cricut work; confirm lab procedures first.
cards.short_summary: A hands-on makerspace inside Orbach Library.
cards.evidence_claim: UCR Library identifies the Creat’R Lab in Orbach Room 140 as a makerspace with 3D printing, sewing/embroidery, and Cricut equipment.
cards.access_notes: Located in Orbach Library, Room 140; review current lab guidance before using equipment.

cards.title: Robotics Lab
cards.subtitle: Orbach Library, Room 146
cards.notes: Use this dedicated project workspace when your work needs robotics hardware, then check the library for current equipment guidance.
cards.short_summary: A library workspace dedicated to robotics projects.
cards.evidence_claim: UCR Library lists the Robotics Lab in Orbach Room 146 as a workspace for robotics projects with Arduino RedBoards and Raspberry Pi equipment.
cards.access_notes: Located in Orbach Library, Room 146; verify current access and equipment procedures with the library.

cards.title: 3D XP Lab
cards.subtitle: Orbach Library, Room 145
cards.notes: Plan a media or VR project here, and ask the library about current use procedures for cameras, scanners and headsets.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated media and virtual-reality development workspace.
cards.evidence_claim: UCR Library describes the 3D XP Lab in Orbach Room 145 as a media and VR development workspace with cameras, a green wall, scanners, and Meta Quest 2 headsets.
cards.access_notes: Located in Orbach Library, Room 145; check current equipment availability before visiting.

cards.title: Highlander Union Building
cards.subtitle: UCR student union
cards.notes: Meet up, attend a scheduled program, or use the building as a shared campus stop; consult the HUB map for room locations.
cards.short_summary: UCR’s student union for programs, events, and downtime.
cards.evidence_claim: The HUB states that its mission is to enhance educational, recreational, and social experiences and invites the campus community to attend programs, schedule events, and relax there.
cards.source_title: Highlander Union Building | HUB | UC Riverside
cards.access_notes: Use the HUB building map and program calendar for current room and event details.

cards.title: UCR Bell Tower
cards.subtitle: Central campus event area
cards.notes: Use the tower as a landmark when heading to a campus program, and check the events calendar for the date, audience and access details.
cards.short_summary: A recognizable campus gathering point used for UCR programs.
cards.evidence_claim: UCR’s events calendar lists R’day at the UCR Bell Tower, and Student Affairs listed the Fall Involvement Fair by the Belltower.
cards.access_notes: Event access and timing vary; check UCR’s event listing before going.

cards.entity_name: a circular sculpture about usefulness amongst other things
cards.title: Arts Walk circular sculpture
cards.subtitle: Outside the Arts building
cards.notes: Walk through the installation and use its concrete furniture for a short outdoor pause; keep clear of any event setup or campus notices.
cards.short_summary: An outdoor, walk-in artwork with seating outside Arts.
cards.evidence_claim: UCR says Roy McMakin’s 5,000-square-foot circular sculpture outside the Arts building includes concrete furniture and garden landscape and is open to the public.
cards.source_title: Arts Walk installation opens | Inside UCR
cards.access_notes: Outdoor public artwork; follow posted campus guidance and any temporary event controls.

cards.title: UCR Botanic Gardens
cards.subtitle: 1 Botanic Gardens Drive
cards.notes: Follow the designated trails through this living museum and check the closure calendar before visiting; do not approach or disturb wildlife.
cards.short_summary: A curated plant collection with designated trails and visitor guidance.
cards.evidence_claim: UCR Botanic Gardens describes itself as a living museum with thousands of curated plant species, provides open hours, and asks visitors to stay on designated trails.
cards.access_notes: Currently posted hours are Monday–Friday 8:00 a.m.–3:30 p.m. and first/third Sundays 8:00 a.m.–2:00 p.m.; last entry is earlier. A $5 adult donation is suggested.

cards.title: Student Recreation Center
cards.subtitle: UCR recreation facility
cards.notes: Use the live schedule to choose a gym, pickup basketball, fitness class or registered activity that fits your day.
cards.short_summary: A recreation hub for exercise, sports, events, and general use.
cards.evidence_claim: UCR Recreation states that all UCR students are automatically SRC members and that the facility supports exercise, sports activities, events, and general recreational use.
cards.access_notes: UCR students are automatically SRC members; consult the recreation site’s current schedule and facility information before arrival.
